blocks.content: The Competition Commission of India (CCI) hosted the Meeting of Heads of BRICS Competition Authorities on 8 August 2026 in Udaipur, Rajasthan, under India’s 2026 BRICS Chairship. The meeting brought together heads and senior representatives of BRICS member competition regulators and adopted a Joint Statement on fair competition in renewable energy markets.

items: The Competition Commission of India is India’s statutory competition regulator under the Competition Act, 2002.
BRICS originally comprised Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa, and the grouping later expanded with new members.
Competition authorities deal with anti-competitive agreements, abuse of dominant position, and combinations or mergers.
Udaipur hosted a BRICS event in 2016 before hosting the 2026 meeting of competition authorities.
